project.purpose: Host Social Work Fabric schema 10: durable Work snapshots, actor references, Space/Topic/Message collaboration and bounded re-entry navigation.

nodes.label: WorkContinuity
nodes.responsibility: Persist Work identity, complete revisioned snapshots and semantic relations for cross-agent re-entry.
acceptance: Use the current source and consumer tests referenced by this node; old Task/Board behavior is covered by explicit retirement tests.
inputs: WorkCreateInput; WorkSnapshotInput; ActorRefInput; exact revision and request identity
outputs: WorkResponse; exact historical snapshot or domain conflict
nodes.behavioralContract: Host-local revision and content identities are preserved; ActorRef is a reference, not authenticated identity; no execution or domain acceptance is granted.

nodes.label: SocialJournal
nodes.responsibility: Persist independent Space/Topic/Message collaboration records and typed relations.
acceptance: Use the current source and consumer tests referenced by this node; old Task/Board behavior is covered by explicit retirement tests.
inputs: SpaceInput; TopicInput; MessageInput; actor and subject references
outputs: Social contract records; exact message and bounded topic pages
nodes.behavioralContract: Spaces can link multiple Works; replies stay within a topic; participation is not authorization; message claims remain claims.

nodes.label: AttentionReentry
nodes.responsibility: Project actor-scoped change navigation and topic re-entry from committed Host rows.
acceptance: Use the current source and consumer tests referenced by this node; old Task/Board behavior is covered by explicit retirement tests.
inputs: ActorRef; change cursor; subscriptions; byte and item budgets
nodes.behavioralContract: Attention change sequence and topic message sequence are distinct coordinates; projection neither ranks nor schedules.

nodes.label: PostgresJournal
nodes.responsibility: Provide PostgreSQL transactions, schema qualification and RFC8785 JSON identity for Host schema 10.
acceptance: Use the current source and consumer tests referenced by this node; old Task/Board behavior is covered by explicit retirement tests.
inputs: PostgreSQL DSN; Alembic-applied schema; typed Host mutations
outputs: Committed rows and receipts; schema/integrity status
nodes.behavioralContract: Alembic owns migration; service startup requires schema 10; Host stores cannot substitute for Runtime ledger or foreign truth.

nodes.label: WorkSnapshotCAS
nodes.responsibility: Commit and read exact complete Work snapshots under revision fencing.
inputs: workRef; ActorRef; WorkSnapshotInput; strict positive expectedRevision; state; request identity
outputs: WorkResponse with revision, snapshotDigest, snapshot, state and admission; typed conflict
nodes.behavioralContract: Only current open Work advances by one revision. Matching response-loss retry may return existing; terminal Work cannot reopen. Read validates payload digest and current pointer; historical reads do not infer historical state.
nodes.semanticProfile: R2.1 state/observation contract; source-qualified, implementation tests are bounded evidence
formalObligations: complete snapshot digest and pointer correspondence
nodes.replacementContract: Preserve revision/content identities, observable replay/conflict behavior and complete history; migrate persisted snapshots before changing substrate.

nodes.label: MessageContentIntegrity
nodes.responsibility: Validate actual persisted message content before exposing it through any content consumer.
outputs: Exact message record or bounded content page; integrity/conflict/not-found failure
nodes.behavioralContract: Recompute RFC8785 identity from actual record fields before comparing optional expected digest. get, search, topic resume and repeated post must reject corrupt content; claims do not become domain facts.
nodes.semanticProfile: R2.1 state/observation contract; source-qualified, implementation tests are bounded evidence
formalObligations: all content read paths enforce the same committed-byte identity
expected digest alone cannot authenticate mutated content
nodes.replacementContract: Retain canonical message identity fields and all-consumer integrity checks; storage/search replacement cannot bypass row verification.

nodes.label: TopicCursorReentry
nodes.responsibility: Resume a bounded topic conversation from its actor-topic message cursor.
inputs: ActorRef; topicRef; message-sequence cursor; item/byte budget
outputs: TopicCursorResponse; TopicResumeResponse with next cursor and hasMore
nodes.behavioralContract: Topic cursor names message sequence, distinct from attention change clock. Acknowledgement is monotone and horizon-bounded; conversation paging preserves exact message integrity and canonical byte budget.
nodes.semanticProfile: R2.1 state/observation contract; source-qualified, implementation tests are bounded evidence
formalObligations: paging does not omit eligible messages
attention navigation to topic coordinate mapping
nodes.replacementContract: Preserve topic message coordinates, bounds, monotonic acknowledgements and record identity; do not replace with global attention cursor.

nodes.label: AttentionChangeHorizon
nodes.responsibility: Route actor-scoped committed changes without skipping unseen relevant events.
inputs: ActorRef; afterSequence in Host change-clock space; limit 1..500; maxBytes; subscriptions
outputs: AttentionDeltaResponse and grouped reentry; monotone attention acknowledgement
nodes.behavioralContract: Read a repeatable-read snapshot horizon. Final/empty pages may advance to the horizon; nonfinal pages cannot jump past relevant changes. Change-clock allocation rolls back transactionally. Attention acknowledgement gives navigation progress only.
nodes.semanticProfile: R2.1 state/observation contract; source-qualified, implementation tests are bounded evidence
formalObligations: no relevant committed change skipped by pagination
nodes.replacementContract: Preserve change-clock/subscription semantics and navigation coordinates; standard PostgreSQL sequence alone does not supply rollback-safe clock behavior.

nodes.label: TypedMessageRelationContinuity
nodes.responsibility: Persist and query explicit typed Message relation edges, with independent client-visible add/list semantics, scoped source/target identity, idempotent receipt, and bounded directional pagination; not a second Message content or topic cursor authority.
nodes.authority: Host SocialStore over Host PostgreSQL journal only
inputs: MessageRelationInput {source_message_ref, relation enum, target_ref, actor_ref} and client_request_id for add
message_ref, direction, optional relation kind, after_change_sequence, limit, max_bytes for list
outputs: Host MessageRelationResponse {admission, sourceMessageRef, relation, targetRef, createdByActorRef, createdAt}
bounded MessageRelationsResponse read projection with changeSequence and pagination
nodes.behavioralContract: The store requires a real actor and source message, validates the typed target according to relation semantics, and commits the typed edge and exact request receipt atomically in PostgreSQL. Duplicate source/relation/target produces existing rather than a second edge. List is a scoped repeatable-read source/target/typed-kind change-sequence projection with explicit bounds. Relation is collaboration metadata; acknowledges does not prove acceptance, mentions does not assign work.
consumers: SocialStore typed relation persistence and directional read clients
mustNotOwn: message-content equality or digest proof supplied by O10
acceptance: MCP service binds both message.relation.add and message.relation.list to exact SocialStore methods, and test_mcp_surface_identity protects the exported tool names.
Source-qualified Postgres test exercises reply_to and mentions typed relation readback with directional projection; all other types and installed clients remain unproven.
Negative direction / pagination / target-scope and response replay are contract obligations; a static source declaration alone does not discharge them.
formalObligations: Transactional uniqueness + exact idempotent receipt and target admissibility of typed edges under concurrent writes
Bounded list ordering, no dropped eligible relation within a declared snapshot/change-sequence horizon
Source/Postgres schema/model to installed Host binary + authenticated MCP principal bridge remains UNKNOWN
No inference from social relation labels to domain authority or replacement equivalence
nodes.replacementContract: Substitute only with consumer-verified add/list wire behavior, relation kind and endpoint semantics, idempotent receipts, bounded direction/filter/paging, same PostgreSQL source state and admitted principal; static compatibility is insufficient.
